title: MAX_ECHO_DATA constant naming implies protocol limit
description:
File: rust/lichen-ipv6/src/lib.rs
Line: 524

Issue: MAX_ECHO_DATA is 120 bytes, derived from build buffer size (128-8), not a protocol limit. The name suggests it is a protocol maximum. For LICHEN LoRa context this is reasonable but could mislead readers.

Suggestion: Rename to ECHO_BUILD_CAPACITY or add clarifying doc comment.
